contracts_rationale: Internal gate behaviour change; no CLI flag, schema, or wire contract is added or changed.
friendly_name: Terminality gate judges every issue-matrix row
purpose_context: The issue-matrix verdict terminality gate let a mission land with an in-mission row whenever that row's issue was not a discovered gating reference, then printed a PASS claiming no unresolved rows. This mission makes the done gate judge every row and report what it judged, while a mission with no matrix still needs none.
purpose_tldr: At done, every in-mission issue-matrix row blocks, and a PASS only describes rows it judged (#6653)
